title: Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.08236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-attention carries a quadratic cost in token count, which limits how far Vision Transformers can scale with input resolution. We introduce SSoG, a separable sum-of-Gaussians spatial operator that replaces dense self-attention with a learned mixture of axis-factorized Gaussian kernels, reducing the per-layer cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to subquadratic in $N$. Unlike dot-product self-attention, whose Lipschitz constant is unbounded outside a compact input domain, SSoG with fixed kernels is globally Lipschitz continuous, which, via the Picard--Lindel\"of theorem, guarantees that the continuous-depth variant has a unique solution on the whole integration interval, a global guarantee that dense-attention counterparts lack in general. On CIFAR-100 at $224\times224$, in a matched discrete-Transformer setting and in the continuous setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 2.2--4.1 points across three model widths while using 8.8--16.6\% fewe

translated_title: 超越二次注意力：面向ODE视觉Transformer的可分离高斯算子
translated_abstract: 自注意力机制的计算成本随token数量呈二次增长，这限制了视觉Transformer随输入分辨率扩展的能力。我们提出SSoG，一种可分离高斯和空间算子，用可学习的轴向分解高斯核混合来替代稠密自注意力，将每层计算成本从 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ 降低到关于 $N$ 的亚二次复杂度。与点积自注意力不同（其在紧致输入域之外Lipschitz常数无界），采用固定核的SSoG具有全局Lipschitz连续性，借助Picard–Lindelöf定理，这保证了连续深度变体在整个积分区间上解的唯一性——这是稠密注意力模型通常所不具备的全局理论保证。在224×224的CIFAR-100实验中，无论是在匹配的离散Transformer设置还是连续设置下，SSoG在三种模型宽度上均将Top-1准确率提升了2.2–4.1个百分点，同时节省了8.8–16.6%的[计算/参数开销]（原文摘要此处截断）。
tldr: SSoG用可分离的高斯和算子替代自注意力，将计算复杂度从O(N²)降至亚二次，并凭借全局Lipschitz连续性保证连续深度ODE解的唯一性，在CIFAR-100上以更少的资源将Top-1准确率提升2.2–4.1个百分点。
en_tdlr: SSoG replaces quadratic self-attention with a separable sum-of-Gaussians operator that achieves subquadratic cost and global Lipschitz continuity (guaranteeing unique solutions for the continuous-depth ODE), improving Top-1 accuracy by 2.2–4.1 points on CIFAR-100 while using 8.8–16.6% fewer resources.
